securityOverviewBlock.title: Security Overview
securityOverviewBlock.description: A compact security scan overview with a score, finding trends, six-area posture and affected assets. Uses existing components and semantic tokens in light, dark and narrow containers.
securityOverviewBlock.compositionBody: Uses Container with ContainerHeader and ContainerFooter, and ContainerBody for the score section and each view. RingChart presents the score, AreaChart stacks four severity counts, and RadarChart compares current and previous posture. Reuses Chart tooltips, legends and data tables, plus SegmentedBar for the severity distribution. Colors follow Chart Tokens and severity semantics.
securityOverviewBlock.dataContractBody: The caller supplies a versioned snapshot with scores, severity counts, window statistics, trends, posture and assets. Open totals are summed from mutually exclusive severity counts; preview lengths never replace collection totals. Unknown values use null, timestamps use UTC milliseconds and median fix time uses hours. Scores and grades come from the caller.
securityOverviewBlock.behaviorBody: Supports four views, controlled 7/30/90-day ranges, scan progress, detail and export callbacks, loading, stale, error and unknown states. Scans retain the previous snapshot until refreshed results arrive. The deterministic demo can simulate failure, inspect full collections and download example JSON; it is not connected to a security scanner.
